llm_response.reason: The website makes outrageous medical claims (instant and permanent cure for arthritis from CBD gummies), uses urgency tactics ('risk free bottle', 'almost gone'), cites fabricated celebrity endorsements (Shark Tank), features unverifiable testimonials, lacks clear business credentials or contact info, and has SSL security issues. These are classic red flags of health supplement scam websites that mimic real media/shows to run fake trial/offers.
